**Become a part of our caring community**
 Humana is seeking a Software Engineer 2 to help develop and support Salesforce Health Cloud solutions that power our growing Primary Care business. In this role, you will contribute to applications that enable sales teams to connect prospective patients with senior\-focused primary care services.
   

  

 Working alongside engineers, product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders, you will help design, build, test, and support Salesforce\-based solutions while growing your expertise in Salesforce technologies, healthcare operations, and modern software engineering practices.
   

  

**Work Style:** 
 Remote / Work at Home
   

  

**Eligible Locations:** 
 Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Charlotte, NC; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; Washington, DC; Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Louisville, KY; Nashville, TN; New York, NY; Tampa, FL.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Salesforce Development \& Configuration**
* Develop and maintain Salesforce Health Cloud solutions using Apex, Flows, OmniStudio, and Lightning Components.
* Configure Salesforce functionality to support business requirements and enhance user experiences.
* Build and support custom workflows, automations, and platform\-based solutions.
* Assist with integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using APIs and integration platforms.
* Participate in the design, testing, deployment, and support of new features and enhancements.
* Follow established engineering standards, coding best practices, and security requirements.


**Collaboration \& Agile Delivery**
* Partner with product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Collaborate across Sales, Operations, Marketing, and IT teams to deliver high\-quality applications.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Contribute to peer code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Communicate project status, technical challenges, and risks effectively.


**Testing \& Support**
* Develop and execute unit tests and support integration and user acceptance testing.
* Troubleshoot application issues and production defects.
* Support application deployments and post\-release validation activities.
* Monitor system performance and identify enhancement opportunities.
* Participate in root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions.
* Support CI/CD processes and software development lifecycle (SDLC) standards.


**Documentation**
* Maintain user stories, technical tasks, and development activities in Azure DevOps (ADO).
* Create and update technical, configuration, and support documentation.
* Document application changes, deployment activities, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Support knowledge transfer and operational readiness documentation.


 At Humana, you'll have the opportunity to build technology that directly supports our mission of helping people achieve their best health. You'll work with modern Salesforce technologies, collaborate across business and IT teams, and grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the healthcare experience of our members and patients.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Use your skills to make an impact**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 2\+ years of software engineering or application development experience.
* 2\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including Apex, Flows, Lightning Components, or OmniStudio.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud; Health Cloud experience is a plus.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, or connected enterprise applications.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered tools to improve development productivity, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Understanding of modern AI concepts such as Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic development.
* Successful completion of Humana's AI skills assessment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified Associate, Salesforce Administrator, or Platform App Builder certification.
* Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using APIs or MuleSoft.
* Experience with JavaScript, web technologies, and modern UI frameworks.
* Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Experience working in healthcare, health insurance, or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and modern application architectures.


 Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.
   

  

 Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.
   

  

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**
 40
   

  

**Pay Range**
 The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.
   

  

 $80,900 \- $110,300 per year
   

  

 This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.
   

  

**Description Of Benefits**
 Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.
   

  

**About Us**
 About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

 It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/enumera:
Enumerate is seeking a PHP & React Software Engineer to help modernize our core product and platform systems across our software and payments ecosystem. We're building a new mobile application on PHP and React Native, and we're looking for an engineer who can help shape it while keeping our existing web application stable and reliable for the customers who depend on it every day.
This is a hands-on role that balances two tracks: building new mobile-facing functionality and APIs, and investigating defects, troubleshooting production issues, and making incremental improvements to an existing vanilla PHP codebase. You'll work closely with Product, QA, and Support to resolve issues and ensure consistent behavior across web and mobile. This role is ideal for an experienced PHP engineer who is energized by modernization work but can also dive into legacy systems - someone who enjoys understanding complex business logic and knows that a stable foundation is what makes new development possible.
This is a remote position, but candidates must be located in LATAM.
Key Responsibilities & Deliverables
Mobile & Platform Development
Help stand up our new React Native mobile application, from project setup through first release.
Build and extend the PHP APIs and services that power it.
Help define how the mobile app integrates with existing systems.
Establish patterns and conventions for mobile development that the team will build on as it grows.
Own features and components end to end, from design discussion through development and release
Identify opportunities to modernize patterns in the existing codebase as new work touches them.
Application Stability & Bug Resolution
Investigate, diagnose, and resolve bugs in a vanilla PHP application.
Debug complex issues across application logic, database interactions, and integrations.
Deliver safe, well-tested fixes that minimize regression risk.
Analyze logs, error reports, and monitoring data to identify root causes.
Collaborate with QA and Support to reproduce reported issues and validate fixes.
Assist with performance improvements and reliability enhancements.
Engineering Practices
Participate actively in code reviews and technical discussions.
Apply agreed-upon standards for code quality, testing, and deployment.
Use AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or something similar) to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.
Contribute incremental improvements to shared utilities or internal tooling.
Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
Required Qualifications
Proven experience working as a PHP engineer delivering production software.
Hands-on React Native experience, including at least one application shipped to the App Store and/or Google Play.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs that service web or mobile clients.
Demonstrated ability to debug and fix issues in large or legacy codebases.
Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL.
Solid understanding of modern development practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD, and automated testing.
Comfortable working independently in a remote role and switching context between new development and production support.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially when tracing complex bugs.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily development workflows.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with PHP applications that integrate with third-party APIs.
Experience incrementally modernizing legacy systems without disrupting production.
Understanding of secure coding practices and data integrity concerns.
Familiarity with mobile-specific concerns such as offline behavior, push notifications, or app release cycles.
Total monthly compensation:
$3,000 — $3,500 USD
